Maria: Heads-up: RCA INC901 follow-ups — need to reconcile assignees + unblock a storage migration dep. Can owners confirm or reassign by EOD Fri? TL;DR: storage-migrate blocks canary; actions below. @Sam @Jin @Priya
Sam: I own the canary rollout step but storage team must finish schema migrate first. I'll reach out to @Lee-storage now. If storage slips, can we move the final window to Mon?
Lee-storage: Storage update: schema migrate currently targeted Thu evening. Risk: need 2-3h maintenance window for index rebuild + queue drain. We can try limited-shard approach to avoid full downtime.
Sam: Limited-shard canary works for us. Action: Sam -> run canary on shard-3 only after schema migrate completes. I'll add a short runbook.
Jin: I picked up the 'eval harness update' item — will have baseline checks by tomorrow noon. That one is not blocking canary.
Priya: I can own the fallback policy config and produce a canary config PR, but I need model-routing details from Sam to set safe thresholds. ETA: Wed.
Devon: I'll take 'alerts tuning' (thresholds + paging rules). Targeting Fri EOD for initial thresholds, then iterate post-canary.
Maria: OK I'm updating the RCA action sheet. Quick check — @Devon is alerts tuning confirmed?
Devon: Confirmed. I'll add notes to the sheet once Sam shares the expected token/run rates.
Sam: Shared preliminary run rates in thread: avg token rate ~120k/min during peak -- will paste snippet to sheet. Also please add owners + ETAs here: https://docs.internal/rca/INC901/actions
Priya: Done — fallback policy owner/ETA added (Wed).
DeployBot: Canary job scheduled: shard-3 -> pending (will trigger after schema:migrate:success).
Maria: Thanks. Final ask: if anyone can't meet the ETA, please ping this thread with alternative dates so we can re-prioritize. :eyes: :thumbsup:
Sam: Quick note — I may need on-call help for the queue-drain step depending on migration timing. @eng-oncall please standby.
Lee-storage: Noted. If we hit unexpected index lock, we'll escalate here and to DB-SRE.
Maria: Great. I'll close this sync once the sheet shows owners for all action rows. Thanks everyone.
